current_app.label: PMP Current v11 single visual owner cleanup

user_facing_rule: Only show PMP Current / PMP-CURRENT-1 as the app version.
home_screen_rule: Install pmp-app-current.html once. It is a stable map-driven door and should change as little as possible.
update_rule: Stop stacking visual fixes. Current v11 does not load pmp-visual-scale-contrast-reset-v1.js. The app returns to the existing visual owner already loaded by the inner app: pmp-native-contrast-bridge-v2.js. The Continuous Run Dashboard remains routed by the dashboard button and should inherit from the same stored visual settings rather than adding another reset layer. This does not start Packet 1.5 or weaken free-only gates.
